notes.title: Trial Version 1.0.2.2 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Fix the issue of ineffective mouse speed settings

Cancelled the mouse speed delay setting (now the mouse speed is faster and can be modified in the settings)

Add Shrine Function

Add random rewards in the corner

notes.title: Demo version update 1.0.1.5
notes.notes:
1. Optimized most of the lagging issues.

2. New melee characters have been updated as trial content.

3. Added new map levels as trial content.

4. Fixed the issue of some props not working correctly.

5. Adjusted the numerical strength of some props.

notes.title: Version update 1.0.0.6
notes.notes:
Thank you for trying the \[Fracturefront Demo]  ! After release, we identified several issues and received great suggestions from players. The following updates have been implemented:
[olist]
Fixed incorrect equipment descriptions or malfunctioning equipment effects.

Adjusted combat maps and scene layouts to provide a wider field of view during battles.

Resolved UI interaction issues and optimized interface content.

Fixed achievement unlocking failures.

Repaired malfunctioning character skills.
[/olist]
If you encounter any problems or need feedback, please contact https://discord.com/invite/ASWWxTHE
